meta.name: Generative Remove (Qwen-Image-2.1, Bbox Object Remover LoRA)
meta.licenseNote: Qwen-Image-2.1 (Alibaba Qwen, 2026-09-20) ships under the Qwen Research License Agreement: research and evaluation use only; commercial use needs a separate agreement with Alibaba. Turn on Allow Research-Only Models in Preferences › AI Integrations to use it.
meta.notes: Served by ShotoPhopEX's native worker (gn-diffusion qwen-2.1/remove): the Qwen-Image-2.1 edit with prithivMLmods' Object Remover Bbox-turbo LoRA (huggingface.co/prithivMLmods/Qwen-Image-2.1-Object-Remover-Bbox-turbo, step 4000, Qwen Research licence) at strength 1 in front of the request's own LoRAs. `highlight: red-box` tells the engine to draw a thin pure-red box around the selection in the request picture and send the LoRA's trigger, `Remove the red highlighted object from the scene.`; the result layer is masked to the selection, so whatever the edit moved outside it stays the picture. Generative Remove's route on Qwen-Image-2.1 when the LoRA is installed (owner's call, 2026-11-19): in the 5090 A/B on 8 removals it scored 21 of 24 at about 6 s warm, against 19 for 2511's Object Remover (24-29 s) and 7 for the plain 2.1 edit. No ComfyUI graph.
meta.creator: prithivMLmods (LoRA), Alibaba Qwen
meta.description: Removes what the selection covers with an adapter trained for it
